title: SS27 Boys' Colour Stories
summary: Three boys' colour stories: Red Line, Pool Brights and Washed Indigo.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- At Playtime Paris, red "emerged as one of the defining colors of the season"; stripes ran horizontal, vertical and diagonal<sup>[1]</sup>
- Pitti Bimbo 103 took "The Pitti Pool" as its theme and called it "the most colorful summer edition yet"<sup>[2]</sup>
- Sport influence was presented "through a more refined, creative lens"; denim felt "stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons"<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Red Line
sections.body: Red, navy and white for stripes, sport and caps.

sections.heading: Pool Brights
sections.body: Aqua, lemon and grass green for swim and camp.

sections.heading: Washed Indigo
sections.body: Light and mid denim with sand and white.

design_implications:
- One capsule per story.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Washed Indigo and Red Line carry volume.

sources.title: Playtime Paris SS27: where fashion met the spirit of a summer music festival
Pitti Bimbo 103: the energy of summer ignites kidswear
